MT-003 made the embedded ModelRuntime the default local LlmClient path, but the embedded model-load path (llm/boot.rs build_default_local_client -> CandleRuntime/LlamaCppRuntime::load) has ZERO SandboxAdapter / ProcessOwnershipLedger wiring (the boxed path is the separate SandboxModelRuntime used only by the swarm factory), which violates master-spec-v02.197 3.6.2/4.6.1 (HARD; MUST fail the 5.6 HBR gate). acceptance_criteria: The default embedded-model load path (llm/boot.rs build_default_local_client) loads the model under the configured SandboxAdapter (default HandshakeNativeSandboxAdapter, master-spec 3.5.2) and registers ProcessOwnershipLedger START on load + STOP on unload (master-spec 3.6.2/4.6.1), so the boxed+ledgered obligation the swarm factory already satisfies also holds for the LlmClient default path; verified with a REAL Candle CPU model load (feature candle-runtime-engine).

DisabledLlmClient (and any fail-closed error return on the default LLM path) emits a Flight Recorder event carrying the disabled/error reason so 'every call emits a Flight Recorder event' (master-spec 4.2.3.2(3)) holds on the error path too; a test proves the FR event is emitted.

The LocalModelRuntimeLlmClient::embedding() path (added by MT-003) emits a Flight Recorder event with trace_id/model_id (embeddings carry no TokenUsage, so record the embedding-appropriate FR shape) so the embedding lane is Flight-Recorder-correlatable per 4.2.3.2(3)/11.5; a test proves emission. (Deferred from MT-003 post-review: embedding() currently carries EmbeddingRequest.trace_id but does not emit, matching the removed OllamaAdapter parity.)

A real-load runtime proof (cargo test --features "test-utils,candle-runtime-engine" against tests/candle_e2e_smoke.rs or a new embedded-default e2e test) shows a ProcessOwnershipLedger START row on load and STOP row on unload for the default embedded model, and no bare std::process::Command model spawn.

pre_implementation_review.full_review_ref: session task a82c84d556b628c94 output (read-only adversarial, file:line evidence)
blockers_and_decisions: P0 AC#1 boxing contradiction: the in-process Candle library load spawns NOTHING, so spec 3.6.2 clause(1) (child of SandboxAdapter, no bare Command) is satisfied VACUOUSLY. DECISION: rewrite AC#1 - the enforced obligation is the ProcessOwnershipLedger START/STOP (clause 2); boxing applies only where a process/guest is actually spawned (swarm + CLI-bridge already boxed).

P0 ledger seam undefined for pid-less load: LedgerDecorator needs a spawn; record_spawn/register_model_process require a non-optional u32 pid and register_model_process is DEAD CODE (0 callers). DECISION: emit via record_start(ProcessStart) with os_pid=None (honest pid-less in-process row); FORBID synthetic pids; downstream consumers must tolerate pid-less rows.

P0 STOP-on-unload unreachable: default client holds Arc<dyn ModelRuntime>, never calls unload (&mut self), no Drop. DECISION: add an explicit client shutdown/close hook (or Drop on the runtime-owning holder) wired into app shutdown that fires the ledger STOP; the STOP proof MUST exercise that seam, not call unload() directly.

P0 proof false-green: named proof candle_e2e_smoke is #[ignore] + skip-if-no-weights and skip counts as pass. DECISION: add a dedicated NON-skippable ledger proof that FAILS (not skips) when it cannot load, asserting START row model_id == minted UUIDv7 + matching STOP + status != Skipped; if real weights are unavailable on host, gate that leg on an operator live-run with a captured ledger dump (state which in proof_targets).

P1 FR-on-error scope too narrow: the REAL default path LocalModelRuntimeLlmClient::completion emits nothing on ALL error branches and embedding() emits nothing at all; DisabledLlmClient emits nothing. DECISION: AC#2/#3 must name these explicitly and require CALL-TIME emission in completion()/embedding() (forbid construction-only emit on DisabledLlmClient). Reuse FlightRecorderEventType::DataEmbeddingComputed for embeddings; for error/disabled reuse LlmInference with zeroed TokenUsage + reason field.

P1 boot path lacks ledger handle: build_default_local_client/resolve_default_llm_client only receive Arc<dyn FlightRecorder>. DECISION: thread a ledger handle through main.rs::init_llm_client (signature change acknowledged).

P1 registry seam overlaps MT-014 (both edit boot.rs ModelRegistry, both depend only on MT-003). DECISION: land MT-013 and MT-014 coordinated (not concurrent worktree edits); ledger metadata_blob carries display_name for MT-008 labeling.

P2 embedding() is a product extension (not in spec 4.2.3.1 LlmClient trait), so FR-on-embedding is a product extension, not a literal 4.2.3.2(3) MUST - label it as such so a validator does not reject on 'embeddings have no TokenUsage'.
P2 NOT_INSPECTED: whether an automated HBR gate actually red-flags an unboxed/unledgered default load today - implementer must verify or add that check rather than assume.

risks: The load path could be 'boxed' only in tests (fake sandbox) and remain unboxed in the real default path.
ProcessOwnershipLedger rows could be emitted without a real reclaim/STOP on unload.
FR-on-error could be added only to DisabledLlmClient construction, missing other fail-closed return points.

Unload/reclaim path proven, not just START.
